news.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
news.headline: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) expected to undergo surgery, miss one month
news.description: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days.
news.impact: Lane could undergo surgery as early as Wednesday. They are hopeful he'll only miss about one month.

news.name: Ty Johnson
news.headline: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited in practice Tuesday
news.description: Ty Johnson was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Johnson was also listed as limited on Monday. He remains up in the air for Thursday's short week game against the Lions.

news.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
news.headline: KeAndre Lambert-Smith placed on IR
news.description: The Chargers placed WR KeAndre Lambert-Smith on injured reserve.
news.impact: Lambert-Smith suffered the injury in the season opener. He will miss at least the next four games.

news.name: Dylan Sampson
news.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee) placed on IR
news.description: The Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve.
news.impact: Sampson went down on Sunday with a knee injury. He will miss at least the next four weeks.
